answer.evidence: Fibre loss is normal and OTDR shows no fault. Power at A-TX is 1.23 dBm and arrives at B-ODF at -8.63 dBm, giving 9.86 dB link loss vs design 9.79 dB. After the in-line attenuator power at B-RX is -18.63 dBm, i.e. 10.0 dB attenuation through B-ATT versus design 3 dB. Receiver power PM dropped from ~-11.7 dBm pre-fault to ~-18.8 dBm after 2026-10-19, matching the extra loss. Site notes record receiver replacement and attenuator refitted from spares box on 2026-10-19 22:45 UTC, the time of onset.

Transmitter output at site A is -3.28 dBm at 1550 nm, below spec -1 to +2 dBm and historic ~1.2 dBm. Performance monitoring shows TX average -2.45 dBm on 2026-10-26 vs ~1.2 dBm historically, and RX average -15.97 dBm with RX_LOW_ALARM active. Measured B-ODF -13.53 dBm and B-RX -16.63 dBm confirm attenuator loss ~3.1 dB as designed, and embedded/OTDR event tables show normal splice losses with no macrobend or fibre break, so link loss is unchanged and the degradation is at the transmitter.

RX power dropped from ~-12.1 dBm to ~-15.4 dBm after patching at site A ODF on 2026-10-18 03:43 UTC. TX power stable at ~1.2 dBm. Power budget shows A-TX 1.07 dBm to B-ODF -8.23 dBm = 9.30 dB loss vs design 5.95 dB, extra ~3.3 dB. OTDR 1550 from A shows first reflective event at launch with loss 3.52 dB. Embedded OTDR from A and B both locate high loss near A. Inspection of A-ODF shows contamination spots on end face; B-ODF clean. Root cause is dirty connector at A-ODF introduced during patching.

OTDR 1550 nm from A shows 2.68 dB reflective loss at -0.001 km at A-ODF launch; embedded OTDR from B shows the same 2.69 dB reflective at 16.977 km. Power measurement shows A-TX 1.97 dBm to B-ODF -4.47 dBm = 6.44 dB loss vs commissioning 3.94 dB, extra ~2.5 dB. Inspection shows damaged end face at A-ODF after patching on 2026-10-24. Cleaning did not help.

RX power dropped ~3 dB on 2026-10-22 to average -15.04 dBm with RX_LOW_WARNING active, fibre loss measured 8.81 dB vs 5.9 dB commissioning. 1550 nm OTDR from A shows non-reflective loss 2.95 dB at 21.711 km, matching SC-06 location at 21.019 km route km, re-entered 2026-10-22 06:45 just before degradation. Embedded OTDR from A shows 5.36 dB loss at 21.71 km confirming a bad splice at SC-06.

RX power fell ~1.4 dB starting 19 Oct after SC-03 was re-entered on 18 Oct. 1550 nm OTDR from A shows non-reflective loss 1.47 dB at 10.634 km matching SC-03 at 10.359 km. Power measurements show fibre loss increased from commissioning 7.62 dB to 8.92 dB (A-TX 0.63 dBm, B-ODF -8.29 dBm). Connectors clean, TX stable. Root cause is bad splice at SC-03 introduced during branch work.

answer.evidence: Service lost on 2026-10-18 with RX_LOS and PRE_FEC_BER_HIGH alarms, RX power dropped from ~-12 dBm to -40 dBm and B-ODF power reads no light. A-TX output is normal at 1.06 dBm. Embedded OTDR from A shows fibre end at 22.317 km and from B at 21.857 km; 1550 nm OTDR from A ends at 22.315 km and from B at 21.849 km, confirming a fibre break about 22.3 km from site A, between splice closures SC-06 (21.24 km) and SC-07 (23.382 km), consistent with road works reported near km 22 on 18 Oct. No connector contamination observed.
